title: Data Engineer
description: Architect distributed data warehouses, resilient ETL/ELT pipelines, real-time streaming architectures, and enterprise lakehouses.

goal.objective: Build dependable, high-throughput, and clean data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver analytical data across the entire organization.

learn.summary: Master distributed data processing with Apache Spark, event streaming with Kafka, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery), orchestration with Airflow, and transformations with dbt.
prerequisites: Strong SQL and relational database concepts
Familiarity with cloud storage and Linux

capstone_projects.title: End-to-End Clickstream Data Lakehouse Pipeline
capstone_projects.description: Design an event streaming pipeline ingesting millions of clickstream events, deduplicating them, and building star-schema marts in Snowflake.

capstone_projects.title: Real-Time Lakehouse Streaming Engine
capstone_projects.description: Build an end-to-end streaming data pipeline ingesting clickstream events from Kafka into an ACID-compliant Delta Lake, orchestrating continuous micro-batches with PySpark.

interview_focus: Star Schema vs Snowflake Schema Modeling
Spark Partitioning, Shuffling & Data Skew Optimization

tree.name: Foundational Skills for Data Engineers
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable data engineering foundation: master Python data pipelines, relational query optimization, Linux systems administration, and version-controlled data repository workflows.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (12 hours) (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Python Programming Essentials
children.description: Master production Python for data engineering: memory-efficient generators (`yield`), object-oriented pipeline design, vectorized numerical processing with NumPy, high-speed tabular manipulation with Polars and Pandas 2.0 (PyArrow backend), and type hinting with Pydantic for schema validation.

resources.title: Effective Python: 90 Specific Ways to Write Better Python
Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [Tutorial]

children.name: Advanced SQL & Relational Databases
children.description: Master advanced SQL and relational database internals: window functions (`ROW_NUMBER`, `RANK`, `DENSE_RANK`, `LEAD`, `LAG`), recursive Common Table Expressions (CTEs), ACID transaction isolation levels, query execution plan analysis (`EXPLAIN ANALYZE`), and indexing strategies (B-Tree, GIN, BRIN for timeseries).

resources.title: SQL Window Function | How to write SQL Query using RANK, DENSE RANK, LEAD/LAG
SQL Window Function | How to write SQL Query using RANK, DENSE RANK, LEAD/LAG

children.name: Version Control with Git
children.description: Implement disciplined Git workflows for data platforms: managing dbt and Spark repositories, branch protection, CI/CD automated test gates, and managing semantic versioning across data transformation artifacts.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Linux & Shell Scripting Basics
children.description: Master Linux data manipulation and scripting: text stream processing with `awk`, `sed`, `grep`, `jq` for JSON wrangling, process monitoring (`htop`, `iostat`), crontab scheduling, and shell automation scripts.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Networking & OS Fundamentals
children.description: Understand operating systems and network protocols for distributed data: socket communication, TCP/IP tuning for high-throughput bulk transfers, file descriptors, Linux page cache writeback behavior, and cloud VPC peering.

resources.title: Computer Networking Course - Network Fundamentals for Beginners

tree.name: Data Modeling & Warehousing
tree.description: Architect enterprise data models and storage layers: dimensional modeling, Lakehouse table formats, and cloud data warehouse architectures.

resources.title: Database Design Course - Learn to create a database from scratch
Data Warehousing Tutorial for Beginners | Data Warehousing Concepts | Data Engineering | Simplilearn

children.name: Dimensional Modeling & Schema Design
children.description: Master Ralph Kimball dimensional modeling: Star vs Snowflake schemas, Fact tables (transaction, periodic snapshot, accumulating snapshot), Dimension tables, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 overwrite, SCD Type 2 historical row versioning with valid dates, SCD Type 3), and surrogate keys vs natural keys.

resources.title: What is Dimensional Modeling? Star Schema & Snowflake Schema | Data Warehousing Tutorial | Simplilearn

children.name: Data Lake & Data Lakehouse Architectures
children.description: Architect modern open Data Lakehouses: ACID transactions on cloud object storage using Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi; metadata catalogs (AWS Glue, Project Nessie, Unity Catalog); hidden partitioning; schema evolution; and time travel queries.

resources.title: Data Lake vs Data Warehouse Explained (What's the Difference?)
Data Lakehouse Architecture Explained | Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi

children.name: Cloud Data Warehouses Deep Dive
children.description: Master modern cloud analytical warehouses: Snowflake (multi-cluster virtual warehouses, zero-copy cloning, micro-partitioning, Snowpipe streaming), Google BigQuery (serverless slot allocation, partitioned and clustered tables, BI Engine), and Amazon Redshift (RA3 nodes, distribution keys, sort keys).

resources.title: Data Warehouse Tutorial For Beginners | Data Warehouse Concepts
Cloud Data Warehouses Explained: BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift & Synapse Analytics

children.name: NoSQL Databases Concepts
children.description: Select and integrate NoSQL data stores: wide-column stores (Apache Cassandra / ScyllaDB for high-velocity writes and partition key design), document stores (MongoDB), key-value caches (Redis for fast lookup), and graph databases (Neo4j).

children.name: Data Marts & Data Virtualization
children.description: Design focused analytical data marts and query virtualization: Trino / Presto distributed query engines for federated querying across heterogeneous sources without moving data, and semantic layer integration.

resources.title: Data Warehouse Tutorial For Beginners | Data Warehouse Concepts
DBT (Data Build Tool)  | Top 10 DBT Interview Questions and Answers for Experienced

tree.name: Batch Data Pipelines
tree.description: Engineer resilient, high-volume batch processing pipelines: Apache Spark distributed computing, dbt SQL transformations, and columnar storage formats.

resources.title: Data Engineering with Python and AI/LLMs (freeCodeCamp)
Apache Airflow Full Course for Data Engineering

children.name: ETL/ELT Concepts & Data Ingestion
children.description: Design robust ingestion architectures: evaluating ETL (Extract-Transform-Load) vs modern ELT (Extract-Load-Transform), batch data replication tools (Airbyte, Fivetran), CDC (Change Data Capture with Debezium), and idempotency guarantees.

resources.title: ETL vs ELT - What's the Difference?
Data Warehouse vs Data Lake vs Data Lakehouse | ETL, OLAP vs OLTP
Data Warehouse vs Data Lake vs Data Lakehouse | ETL, OLAP vs OLTP

children.name: Distributed Processing with Apache Spark
children.description: Master distributed data processing with Apache Spark & PySpark: DataFrame and Dataset APIs, the Catalyst query optimizer and Tungsten execution engine, managing partitions (`repartition` vs `coalesce`), broadcast hash joins vs shuffle hash joins, mitigating data skew with salting, and tuning Spark executor memory (`spark.executor.memory`, `spark.sql.shuffle.partitions`).

resources.title: PySpark Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course (2023)

children.name: Data Transformation with dbt
children.description: Master modern analytics engineering with dbt (data build tool): organizing multi-layer data transformations (Staging, Intermediate, Marts), materialization strategies (table, view, incremental with merge/delete+insert strategies), authoring reusable Jinja macros, and dbt packages.

resources.title: dbt Tutorial for Beginners - Learn dbt (Data Build Tool) from Scratch

children.name: Data Formats & Compression
children.description: Optimize file storage and I/O efficiency: columnar binary formats (Apache Parquet, Apache ORC) with dictionary encoding and run-length encoding, row-oriented serialization with Apache Avro, and evaluating compression codecs (Snappy for fast decompression vs ZSTD for high compression ratio).

resources.title: Parquet, ORC, Avro: What's the Difference for Data Engineers
GZIP vs Snappy vs Zstd Explained | Compression Algorithms for Data Engineers

children.name: Practice Lab: Data Cleansing & Transformation
children.description: Build automated data cleaning and deduplication pipelines: handling nulls, type coercion, fuzzy matching, outlier detection, and writing deterministic transformation rules in PySpark and SQL.

resources.title: Data Cleaning in Python with Pandas (Numpy, Matplotlib) - Full Course

tree.name: Streaming Data Pipelines
tree.description: Engineer real-time streaming architectures: event streaming with Apache Kafka, stream processing engines, and event-driven patterns.

resources.title: The Log: What every software engineer should know about real-time data's unifying abstraction
🔥 Streaming Data Architecture: Build Real-Time Systems with Kafka & Stream Processing
Apache Flink Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course

children.name: Event Streaming with Apache Kafka
children.description: Master Apache Kafka event streaming: broker clusters, topic partitioning and consumer group rebalances, producer acknowledgment settings (`acks=all`), consumer commit strategies, Schema Registry (Avro/Protobuf schema evolution rules), and Kafka Connect for source/sink streaming.

resources.title: 🔥 Streaming Data Architecture: Build Real-Time Systems with Kafka & Stream Processing

children.name: Stream Processing Frameworks
children.description: Master stateful stream processing: Apache Flink and Spark Structured Streaming, processing event-time vs processing-time, watermarking to handle late-arriving data, windowing functions (tumbling, sliding, session), checkpointing, and exactly-once processing guarantees.

resources.title: Apache Spark Full Course - Learn Apache Spark in 3 Hours | Spark Structured Streaming, PySpark, Spark ML
Apache Flink Tutorial for Beginners | Learn Apache Flink Fundamentals

children.name: Real-time Data Ingestion & APIs
children.description: Implement ultra-low latency real-time ingestion: streaming events directly into cloud lakehouses and analytical stores using Kafka Connect, Snowpipe Streaming, or BigQuery Storage Write API.

resources.title: AWS Kinesis Data Streams Developer Guide
🔥 Streaming Data Architecture: Build Real-Time Systems with Kafka & Stream Processing

children.name: Event-Driven Architecture Patterns
children.description: Apply distributed event architectural patterns: Event Sourcing, CQRS, Change Data Capture (CDC) via database transaction logs, and the Transactional Outbox Pattern to guarantee reliable event dispatch.

resources.title: Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) Explained - System Design for Beginners
What is Event Sourcing? - System Design Explained

tree.name: Workflow Orchestration & Monitoring
tree.description: Orchestrate and monitor enterprise data workflows: Apache Airflow, containerization, data quality assertions, and continuous integration.

resources.title: The Rise of the Data Orchestration Layer
Apache Airflow Tutorial - Workflow Orchestration with Python

children.name: Workflow Orchestration with Apache Airflow
children.description: Master workflow orchestration with Apache Airflow 2.x: authoring DAGs using the TaskFlow API (`@task`, `@dag`), configuring execution backends (CeleryExecutor, KubernetesExecutor), custom operators, sensors, XCom data passing limits, dynamic DAG generation, and handling task retries with exponential backoff.

resources.title: Apache Airflow Tutorial for Beginners | Getting Started with Airflow

children.name: Containerization with Docker
children.description: Containerize data workloads with Docker: multi-stage Dockerfiles for Spark drivers and Airflow workers, managing dependencies, and running local multi-service data stacks using Docker Compose.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]
Docker Crash Course For Absolute Beginners

children.name: CI/CD for Data Pipelines
children.description: Build enterprise CI/CD pipelines for data: automated linting with SQLFluff and Ruff, running automated dbt tests in CI against ephemeral staging schemas, and automated pipeline deployment with GitHub Actions.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course
GitHub Actions Tutorial - CI/CD for Beginners

children.name: Monitoring, Logging & Alerting
children.description: Implement data pipeline observability: capturing execution logs, monitoring DAG run durations, emitting Prometheus metrics, and configuring PagerDuty / Slack alerts for failed pipeline tasks.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners [Full Course in 3 Hours]
What is the ELK Stack | ELK | Elasticsearch | Logstash | Kibana

tree.name: Cloud Data Platforms, MLOps & Governance
tree.description: Govern and operationalize data: cloud ecosystems, data contracts, quality frameworks, and feature stores.

resources.title: MLOps for Beginners | Deploy a Machine Learning Model with MLOps

children.name: Cloud Data Platform Ecosystems (AWS/GCP/Azure)
children.description: Architect end-to-end data stacks on major cloud providers: AWS (S3, EMR, Glue, Athena, Redshift), GCP (GCS, Dataproc, BigQuery, Dataflow), or Azure (ADLS Gen2, Synapse, Databricks, Fabric).

resources.title: AWS vs. Azure vs. GCP: In-Depth Comparison of Cloud Services

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
children.description: Provision cloud data infrastructure declaratively: writing Terraform modules to deploy S3 buckets, Snowflake databases/warehouses, IAM service roles, and Airflow clusters.

resources.title: Terraform Course - From BEGINNER to PRO! (Create, Deploy, and Manage AWS Infrastructure)

children.name: Data Quality, Observability & Lineage
children.description: Enforce automated data quality and observability: declarative data testing with Great Expectations or Soda Core, tracking data lineage with OpenLineage, and monitoring schema drift and data freshness with Monte Carlo.

resources.title: Data Quality, Observability, and Lineage Explained (Data Engineering Explained)
Great Expectations Tutorial | Data Quality with Python

children.name: Data Governance, Security & Privacy
children.description: Implement enterprise data governance: data cataloging with Apache Atlas or DataHub, role-based access control (RBAC), column-level encryption, dynamic data masking, and complying with GDPR / HIPAA regulations.

resources.title: BigQuery Best Practices for Cost Optimization
What is Data Privacy? (Explained with Examples)

children.name: Introduction to MLOps for Data Engineers
children.description: Bridge data engineering and machine learning: building scalable Feature Stores with Feast, managing training dataset versioning with DVC, and serving low-latency features for ML inference.

resources.title: What is MLOps? Machine Learning Operations Explained

children.name: Data API Design & Serving
children.description: Build high-performance data serving APIs: developing asynchronous REST and GraphQL data access APIs with FastAPI, integrating Redis caching layers, and implementing token-bucket rate limiting.

resources.title: Building REST APIs with Python Flask
API Design Best Practices for REST APIs
What is GraphQL? A quick overview

children.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End Data Platform
children.description: Capstone Project: Architect, Build, and Deploy an Enterprise Real-Time Lakehouse Platform: Change Data Capture from PostgreSQL using Debezium into Apache Kafka, stateful streaming with Spark Structured Streaming into an Apache Iceberg lakehouse, dbt transformations for dimensional analytics, Airflow DAG orchestration, Great Expectations data validation, and complete Terraform IaC provisioning.

resources.title: Public Data Sets for Data Engineering (Kaggle)
How to build an End-to-End Data Pipeline (with Python & AWS)
